name: agoda-scraper-examples
what_it_holds: Runnable Python & JS example client code calling a commercial Apify "Agoda Hotel Scraper" actor to pull hotel listings/room rates/availability/reviews from Agoda. No data committed; requires a paid Apify actor run to acquire anything.
why_useful: Illustrates a working (if paid, third-party) route to Agoda price/availability data as a competitor-supply/pricing proxy (gap 9), but not a free or one-command pull and needs a human ToS/paid-API decision before any run.
themes: Agoda, Trip.com, Tujia, Xiaozhu, Meituan, MakeMyTrip, OYO, Traveloka datasets and scrapers (APAC OTA and STR platforms)
why_all: Illustrates a working (if paid, third-party) route to Agoda price/availability data as a competitor-supply/pricing proxy (gap 9), but not a free or one-command pull and needs a human ToS/paid-API decision before any run.

name: agoda-scraper (PHP)
what_it_holds: Small PHP class (MIT licensed) for scraping agoda.com directly (no third-party paid service dependency). No data committed, 4 stars, appears functional as of last update (2024).
why_useful: The only free/self-hosted (non-paid-actor) Agoda scraping method found; could in principle be adapted to pull current Agoda prices as an APAC hotel-pricing proxy for gap 9, though it targets a non-Airbnb site directly and any run is a ToS decision for a human, per the rules.
themes: Agoda, Trip.com, Tujia, Xiaozhu, Meituan, MakeMyTrip, OYO, Traveloka datasets and scrapers (APAC OTA and STR platforms)

name: factden/agoda-hotel-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: JavaScript Apify actor scraping Agoda hotel reviews at scale: scores, full text, photos, traveler type, stay dates. No bulk dataset committed to the repo itself (runs on Apify). Last updated Sep 7, 2026.
why_useful: Review volume/velocity by traveler type and stay date on Agoda could proxy APAC travel demand seasonality, complementary to the Booking.com review datasets already held.

name: factden/qunar-hotel-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: Apify actor scraping Qunar (Ctrip-owned Chinese OTA) hotel reviews: ratings, sub-scores, text, photos, owner replies, LLM-ready markdown export.
why_useful: Qunar is a large Chinese domestic-travel OTA; reviews could proxy domestic China lodging demand, an otherwise dark region for the team (gap #9, #7).
